description: Four-point statistics of the Leech minimal-vector scheme: for x = C[x], one representative y per class i = class(x,y) and every z, H_z[a][b][c] = #{w : class(x,w)=a, class(y,w)=b, class(z,w)=c}; cells (i,j,k) with j = class(x,z), k = class(y,z). Per cell the distinct histograms (variants) with the number of z carrying each; a cell is regular iff it has one variant. Classes c <-> inner products classes[c] (sqrt(8) scaling).
cells_format: list of {ijk: [i,j,k], n_z: p^i_jk, regular: bool, variants: [{z_count, q: [[a,b,c,count], ...]}]} (count > 0 only; q is the histogram of one z of the variant; for a regular cell it is the four-point number q[i][j][k])
